title: "Table 2. Association Between Armed Conflict and Maternal, Under-5, Infant, and Neonatal Mortality"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false

---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plm)
library(modelsummary)

final_data <- readr::read_csv(
  "../../data/processed/final_data.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

final_data <- final_data |>
  mutate(
    log_gdp = log(gdp_1000)
  )

panel_data <- pdata.frame(
  final_data,
  index = c("iso", "year")
)

maternal_model <- plm(
  maternal_mortality ~
    armed_conflict_lag1 +
    log_gdp +
    oecd +
    pop_dens +
    urban +
    age_dep +
    male_edu +
    temp +
    rainfall_1000 +
    earthquake +
    drought +
    factor(year),
  data = panel_data,
  model = "within",
  effect = "individual"
)

under5_model <- plm(
  under5_mortality ~
    armed_conflict_lag1 +
    log_gdp +
    oecd +
    pop_dens +
    urban +
    age_dep +
    male_edu +
    temp +
    rainfall_1000 +
    earthquake +
    drought +
    factor(year),
  data = panel_data,
  model = "within",
  effect = "individual"
)

infant_model <- plm(
  infant_mortality ~
    armed_conflict_lag1 +
    log_gdp +
    oecd +
    pop_dens +
    urban +
    age_dep +
    male_edu +
    temp +
    rainfall_1000 +
    earthquake +
    drought +
    factor(year),
  data = panel_data,
  model = "within",
  effect = "individual"
)

neonatal_model <- plm(
  neonatal_mortality ~
    armed_conflict_lag1 +
    log_gdp +
    oecd +
    pop_dens +
    urban +
    age_dep +
    male_edu +
    temp +
    rainfall_1000 +
    earthquake +
    drought +
    factor(year),
  data = panel_data,
  model = "within",
  effect = "individual"
)

models <- list(
  "Maternal mortality" = maternal_model,
  "Under-5 mortality" = under5_model,
  "Infant mortality" = infant_model,
  "Neonatal mortality" = neonatal_model
)

modelsummary(
  models,
  stars = TRUE,
  coef_omit = "factor\\(year\\)"
)
```
